submitted.rationale: At 2.1 eV illumination, the Mg–Sb–O line is essentially photo-inactive. MgO and the Mg antimonates (MgSb2O6 etc.) are wide-gap insulators. I spread 5 EQE measurements across the whole line (Sb 0.08–0.81) and every result was within about ±0.001% of zero, which is at noise level. Index 0 (Sb 0.085) had the highest measured value, 0.00092%, but it is not meaningfully different from the other points.
